update: Only explicit offpulse_enable AND per-channel sample_good; first sample seeds; EWMA estimate += or -= abs(power-estimate)>>ewma_shift
shift: Unsigned 0..31; 0 selects latest sample; changed shift invalidates previous estimate history
power_format: Unsigned 32-bit I^2+Q^2 in IQ16 count-squared units, maximum 2^31
freshness: At snapshot edge use prior age < max_age_cycles; last update on preceding edge is age 0 and one elapsed cycle; max_age_cycles=0 means unqualified; age saturates
context: context_version must identify source, time epoch, calibration and estimator settings; changes invalidate estimator history; snapshot retains result_context
snapshot: One owned result; reads pre-edge estimate, never same-edge new sample; no replacement on same edge as retirement; rejected pulses identify invalid requests
clear: Explicit clear invalidates live estimates and rejects new snapshot; existing owned snapshot remains immutable until consumed; reset cancels both
window_conversion: Frozen power times final sample_count; count 1..16384; reject power>2^31; 47-bit intermediate and exact 46-bit valid result
upstream_obligations: qualify off-pulse samples, not simply invert detector active
exclude FIR tails, source settling, uncertain onset and interference
increment context version on applicable changes
join pulse/context IDs with final window before SNR evaluation
scope_limit: noise_known means seeded fresh estimate in matching context, not proof of calibrated noise/SNR confidence; no physical gain constants or production binding inferred
